azimuth_convention: 0 deg = straight ahead of the zebra's head, positive to the right; elevation 0 = horizon, positive up

acuity_map.formula: A(az, el) = A_regime * max(floor, exp(-el^2 / (2 sigma_el^2)) * max(0, 1 - (1 - falloff_90) * |az| / 90))
acuity_map.source: configs/eye.yaml streak block (Timney & Keil 1992; Guo & Sugita 2000; Harman et al. 1999)

total_horizontal_fov_deg.note: no verified source found; commonly quoted for horses

binocular_zone_deg.source: 65 deg Crispin 1990, 80 deg Harman et al. 1999, as cited in Frontiers Vet Sci 2025 doi 10.3389/fvets.2025.1647911 (secondary)

blind_zones.name: behind the head
blind_zones.note: 360 - total FOV; width depends on head carriage

blind_zones.name: in front of the forehead / below the nose
blind_zones.note: Harman et al. 1999 describe a blind area in front of the forehead

panoramic_addon: not implemented: values here come from configs/eye.yaml plus the approximate zones above
